parameters.jsonOutput:
={{ {
  storyId: $('Merge').first().json.storyId,
  outlineId: $('Merge').first().json.storyId + '-O01',
  conceptId: $('Merge').first().json.conceptId,
  title: $('Merge').first().json.title,

  opening: $json.output.opening,
  setup: $json.output.setup,
  incitingIncident: $json.output.incitingIncident,
  risingAction: $json.output.risingAction,
  climax: $json.output.climax,
  resolution: $json.output.resolution,
  emotionalArc: $json.output.emotionalArc,
  lesson: $json.output.lesson,

  targetLengthMinutes: Number($('Merge').first().json.targetLengthMinutes),

  canonReferences: [
    'MILO_CHARACTER.md',
    'MILO_BACKSTORY.md',
    'VOICE_GUIDE.md',
    'VISUAL_REFERENCE.md',
    'PERSONALITY_RULES.md'
  ],

  approvalStatus: 'PENDING_REVIEW',
  approvalProcessedAt: '',
  createdAt: $now.toISO(),
  updatedAt: $now.toISO(),
  version: 1
} }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ /^MILO-[0-9]{3}$/.test($json.storyId ?? '') && $json.outlineId === (($json.storyId ?? '') + '-O01') && /^MILO-[0-9]{3}-C[0-9]{2}$/.test($json.conceptId ?? '') && ($json.conceptId ?? '').startsWith(($json.storyId ?? '') + '-') && ['title','opening','setup','incitingIncident','risingAction','climax','resolution','emotionalArc','lesson'].every(field => typeof $json[field] === 'string' && $json[field].trim().length > 0) && Number($json.targetLengthMinutes) > 0 && Array.isArray($json.canonReferences) && JSON.stringify($json.canonReferences) === JSON.stringify(['MILO_CHARACTER.md','MILO_BACKSTORY.md','VOICE_GUIDE.md','VISUAL_REFERENCE.md','PERSONALITY_RULES.md']) && $json.approvalStatus === 'PENDING_REVIEW' && Number($json.version) === 1 && typeof $json.createdAt === 'string' && $json.createdAt.length > 0 && typeof $json.updatedAt === 'string' && $json.updatedAt.length > 0 }}
